events.verdict: Curry (GSW) and Fox (SAC) engage and separate.
Hield (SAC) makes incidental foot to foot contact with Cauley-Stein (SAC) and the contact dislodges him.
Curry (GSW) maintains a legal guarding position on Bogdanovic (SAC) during the drive.
Curry (GSW) maintains a legal guarding position during the jump shot attempt by Bogdanovic (SAC).
Hield (SAC) has a hand on the opposite side hip of Thompson (GSW) but removes it as Thompson moves away and the contact does not affect his SQBR.
Iguodala (GSW) establishes himself in a screening position in the path of Bogdanovic (SAC) and gives him room to avoid the contact.
Green (GSW) establishes himself in a screening position in the path of Jackson (SAC) and gives him room to avoid the contact.
Jackson (SAC) maintains a legal guarding position on Durant (GSW) at the end of the drive when Durant loses control of his dribble.
Green (GSW) ties up the ball with Hield (SAC) and a jump ball is correctly called.
Bjelica (SAC) enters the jump ball circle before the ball is tossed and does not re-establish outside the circle before the tip.
Curry (GSW) maintains a legal guarding position on Fox (SAC) on the drive and Green (GSW) steals the errant pass.
Curry (GSW) and Jackson (SAC) engage and separate on the screen.
Green (GSW) maintains a legal guarding position on Hield (SAC) at the start of the drive and cleanly dislodges the ball from Hield, temporarily.
{Observable in Enhanced Video} Hield (SAC) splits his feet at the start of his dribble.
Cauley-Stein (SAC) delivers slight contact to the back of Iguodala (GSW) during the rebound but does not affect his ability to go for the ball.
Durant (GSW) establishes himself in a screening position in the path of Hield (SAC) and gives him room to avoid the contact.
Jackson (SAC) maintains a legal guarding position on Curry (GSW) during the drive.
Iguodala (GSW) establishes himself in a screening position in the path of Jackson (SAC) and gives him room to avoid the contact.
Green (GSW) maintains a legal guarding position during the play at the basket by Jackson (SAC).
Hield (SAC) commits a take foul on Curry (GSW).
Cauley-Stein (SAC) establishes himself in a screening position in the path of Green (GSW) and gives him room to avoid the contact.
Green (GSW) maintains a legal guarding position during the jump shot attempt by Hield (SAC) and cleanly dislodges the ball.
